items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Sid Weiss was a good bass player... The band was really swinging

ctx.x: Now explain who rode together in what cars?
I rode with Billy and Sid Weiss, down
through the south, and we wouldn't -- they wouldn't let Billie eat in the diner or the restaurants unless she went and sat in the kitchen. So we all sat in the kitchen with her.
